[CI] Limit all workflow jobs to 10 minutes (#834)

[written by Codex]

## Description

The workflows lack explicit job limits except for Semgrep, which allows
eight hours. This PR caps every CI, Semgrep, version-bump, and publish
job at 10 minutes so stalled runs stop while normal runs have headroom.

The last 20 successful runs of each workflow had these durations,
excluding the initial queue or approval wait:

| Workflow | Average | Slowest sampled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CI | 2m 17s | 3m 35s |
| Semgrep | 1m | 1m 25s |
| Publish Package | 3m 11s | 4m 33s |
| Increment Version | 32s | 1m 30s |

CI durations measure elapsed time across the parallel matrix, not the
sum of its jobs. The Semgrep sample contains PR scans. Version-bump
samples span April–October 2026; the other samples are more recent.

## How was this change tested?

- [ ] Automated test (unit, integration, etc.)
- [x] Manual test (provide reproducible testing steps below)

Compared the limits with successful workflow durations and validated all
workflow files with actionlint and Prettier.
